about: V3-1 (b) semantic cost of predicting column when the truth is row. Pair = (A older, B newer); directed relations read 'B <relation> A'. EDITABLE BY TRAVIS UNTIL THE FIRST RUN (amended once, 2026-09-28, before any run: see AMENDMENT_1.md); score.py records the sha256 of the matrix it used. 'given' cells come from the T4 draft relayed 2026-09-28; 'filled' cells are Claude's completion of the same rule and are the ones most worth checking.
invariant: Graphonomous should prefer missing a relation over asserting a materially wrong relation.

given: abstain when a relation exists: 1 (every row's abstain)
unrelated / scope_disjoint predicted when a meaningful relation exists: 2
duplicate asserted over distinct claims: 5 (every non-duplicate row's duplicate column)
refines asserted where the newer claim materially changes or rejects the older (supersedes, contradicts, evidence_against rows): 5
true supersedes -> abstain 1, -> unrelated 2; true contradicts -> abstain 1
filled: duplicate -> refines: 3 (weak: both say the claims agree)
supersedes -> evidence_against: 3 and contradicts -> evidence_against: 3 (weaker claim of the same polarity)
evidence_against -> contradicts: 7 (negative evidence is not contradiction: counted as a false contradicts)
refines asserted over unrelated / scope_disjoint pairs: 5 (a false relation, priced like a false duplicate)
unrelated <-> scope_disjoint: 1 (neither mutates meaning; a review-sized error)
amended_by_travis_2026_09_28: supersedes -> contradicts: 5 (was 2): it avoids a false supersession but still asserts a materially false conflict
unrelated -> abstain: 0 (was 1): if no semantic edge exists, refusing to assert one is not a failure
scope_disjoint -> abstain: 1 (kept): explicit scope knowledge is lost, the graph stays safe

kept as filled: supersedes -> evidence_against 3, contradicts -> evidence_against 3, evidence_against -> contradicts 7, unrelated/scope_disjoint -> refines 5, unrelated <-> scope_disjoint 1, duplicate -> refines 3
evidence_for <-> evidence_against stays 6: reversing the sign of evidence is a serious error, not a neighbouring-label slip

governing_rule: Cost follows the semantic damage of the false assertion, not the distance between labels: missed relation / abstention 1; safe under-assertion 2-3; false equivalence or refinement 5; false evidence direction 6+; false contradiction 7; false supersession 10. Refusing to assert an edge where none exists costs nothing.
